summary: In the 2.4 to 2.6 upgrade, controller OAuth applications and controller personal access tokens are deprecated: existing ones can be viewed, edited and keep working, but new ones cannot be created. Platform gateway OAuth applications and tokens are the standard to migrate to.
questions: What happens to controller OAuth applications after upgrading to 2.6?
Can I still create automation controller OAuth applications in 2.6?
Are controller personal access tokens deprecated?
Should I migrate to platform gateway tokens?
